notes.title: Update Notice (January 14, 2025)
notes.content:
Update Notice (January 14, 2025)

We’ve made updates to enhance gameplay.
Notable changes include fixing incorrect descriptions, adding missing items, and adjusting probabilities.
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: We hope this update makes Hell Shooter even more enjoyable for you.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195573/edbc2a9fca5335bf8ccc7df0daabecf77abc4bf0.png

Hello, this is Play Mephistowaltz.

We’ve made some updates and adjustments to improve your gaming experience. We hope this update makes Hell Shooter even more enjoyable for you.

1. Fixed typos and minor bugs.
2. You can now view precise stats.
3. Item descriptions have been made more concise.
4. Adjusted the amount of gold obtained on the 4th floor.
5. Updated the visuals of the loading screen.
6. Removed the shop enhancement effect and adjusted the appearance rate of items in the shop.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Hell Shooter is Now Available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195573/edbc2a9fca5335bf8ccc7df0daabecf77abc4bf0.png

About the Game
Hell Shooter is a roguelike dungeon exploration game that features a unique attack system, thrilling action, an oriental-styled hellish atmosphere, and captivating storytelling for each character.

Unique Attack System
You must defeat enemies using only dashes! Bounce between structures and enemies to design the most optimal attack path.

Soul Burst
Great play deserves great rewards. Fill your combo gauge and unleash a powerful Soul Burst to crush your enemies in one blow!

100+ Items
Numerous items will aid you in your adventure. Collect more items to unleash even stronger attacks.

Ghosts of the Underworld
Encounter ghosts with unique stories of their own.

Replayability-focused Design
Experience an ever-changing underworld with each expedition. Death is not the end—earn currency through exploration to purchase upgrades and items!
